chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 536: The Stone Spear in the Ruined City
chapter_meta_description: The Curse Realm's great formation wounds Ancestral Gods. Xiao Chen's group sacrifices an Otherworld god and discovers a mysterious stone spear in a ruined city beneath the Death World's Nether River.
og_title: World of Immortality 536: The Stone Spear Emerges
og_description: The Curse Realm's formation injures multiple Ancestral Gods. Xiao Chen's party discovers a ruined city and a stone spear guarded by a half-petrified being in the Death World.
